infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SmartForce 360 records your location only while you are on duty, so your supervisor can see you are safe at your post.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: While you are on duty, SmartForce 360 keeps recording your location when the app is in the background. Recording stops when you end duty.
